sources.title: Illinois General Assembly - 805 ILCS 180/50-10, Limited Liability Company Act fees

amount.note: Fee set by statute for filing domestic articles of organization. An LLC with a series pays a higher fee, which is not used here.

annual.label: Annual report fee
annual.due: Within the 60 days before the first day of the LLC's anniversary month each year.

sources.title: Illinois General Assembly - 805 ILCS 180/50-10, Limited Liability Company Act fees
Illinois General Assembly - 805 ILCS 180/50-1, annual report

amount.note: Fee set by statute for an LLC annual report. Each series with a certificate of designation adds a further fee, which is not used here. The report is due before the anniversary month, so the first one falls in the year after formation.

notIncluded.label: Series LLC fees
notIncluded.reason: Only for an LLC with series. Filing articles for a series LLC and each series on the annual report cost extra.

sources.title: Illinois General Assembly - 805 ILCS 180/50-10, Limited Liability Company Act fees

notIncluded.label: Late annual report penalty
notIncluded.reason: Only if the annual report is filed late.

sources.title: Illinois General Assembly - 805 ILCS 180/50-10, Limited Liability Company Act fees

notIncluded.label: Registered agent service
notIncluded.reason: Only if you hire a registered agent. The agent sets the price, so it is not a state fee and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Name reservation
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Reserving a name before you file is a separate charge and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Expedited filing and certified copies
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Faster processing and certified copies cost extra and are not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Local business licenses and permits
notIncluded.reason: City, county and industry licenses depend on where the business operates and what it does. None are in the total.

notIncluded.label: Federal and state income taxes
notIncluded.reason: Taxes on the LLC's or its owners' income are not part of this estimate. This page is not legal or tax advice.

content.intro: {state} sets its LLC fees in the Limited Liability Company Act: a one-time fee to file Articles of Organization and an annual report fee each year after that.

howItWorks.text: The Act lists the fee for filing domestic articles of organization and a higher fee for an LLC with series. The estimate uses the standard fee.
The annual report must reach the Secretary of State in the sixty days before the LLC's anniversary month begins, so the first report falls in the year after formation.

faq.q: Does a series LLC in {state} cost more?
faq.text: Yes. The Act sets a higher fee for articles of an LLC with series, and an extra amount for each series on the annual report.
